optDisplayTextEnPlaceholder: EN — e.g. We must act now
optDisplayTextHint: The button text shown to the player. Leave blank to fall back to the localization key.
optHiddenEffectLabel: hidden_effect (hidden effect — executes but not shown)
autoFireAfterDaysLabel: auto_fire_after_days (delay after start in days · 0=same tick · 1=common for time-travel super events)
onActionHint: "" = uses trigger / MTTH (default) · "on_startup" = auto-fire at start · others = game event hooks (war start / monthly / annexation / ...). Mutually exclusive with the "Auto-fire at start" checkbox above — once a hook is selected, the days below use the auto_fire_after_days field.
immediateLabel: immediate (runs immediately after the event fires)
afterLabel: after (runs after an option is chosen — optional)
optionsEmpty: No options yet. Add at least one option for the player to choose.
eventPictureUploadHint: PNG / JPG / DDS · 210 × 176 · auto-converted to DDS at export · GFX name auto-generated
optEffectTooltipHint: Effects like add_to_variable / set_country_flag show no automatic tooltip on the option button. Type the text here and export inserts custom_effect_tooltip into this option and ships the loc.
